title: Validate isolated Obsidian capture smoke

source.summary: Exercise deterministic graph writes in an isolated safe temporary vault.

decisions.rationale: Prevent test writes to the live knowledge graph

result: The isolated pipeline writes a linked graph and receipt deterministically.
reusable_lesson: Run both first-write and identical no-op checks before enabling a live capture.

verification.evidence: Dry-run, first capture, and identical replay are executed in sequence.
